title: .ai-orchestrator/deploy.yaml
description: How the deployer on the VPS builds, runs and smoke-tests the apps of a project (release-workflow spec 2.3, 2.9). It names only the apps, their Dockerfile, port, health path and the names of their environment variables: no volume, privileged mode, host network or published port can be written here.

database.description: The PostgreSQL of the project, one container for each environment that the deployer keeps apart from the deploys, with the alias db on the network of the environment (project-scaffold part 3, spec 2.4). Its variables come from /etc/ao/secrets/<project>/<environment>.db.env.

image.description: The image pinned by digest, such as postgres:17-alpine@sha256:<64 hex>.

init.description: The folder of scripts that set an empty database up, from the root of the repo; they run once, when the volume is new.

memory.description: The memory cap of the container; 256m when absent.

path.description: A path of the app on its own host: starts with one slash, so it can never name another host.

dockerfile.description: Path of the Dockerfile from the root of the repo, which is also the build context.

context.description: The folder the image builds from, from the root of the repo; the root when absent. A Dockerfile made for the folder of its app, such as that of a Spring Boot template, needs it (project-scaffold part 3, spec 2.5).

memory.description: The memory cap of the container, such as 512m or 1g; 512m when absent (project-scaffold part 3, spec 2.5).

start_timeout.description: Seconds the smoke test waits for the app to answer; 60 when absent. A JVM app that migrates its database at start needs more.

env.description: Names of the environment variables; their values live on the VPS in /etc/ao/secrets.
